context_for_next_testing_agent: Script LIBRAS feature fully implemented and tested. The feature allows users to enter narration text per slide that will be automatically translated to Brazilian Sign Language (LIBRAS) by the VLibras avatar when the course is viewed in SCORM or HTML export. Key files: Editor.jsx (lines 4661-4674 for UI), models.py (line 156 for librasScript field), player.js (lines 860-872 for SCORM VLibras integration), html_exporter.py (lines 2230-2242 for HTML VLibras integration).
